feed.title: DevCentr News
feed.subtitle: News and engineering blog posts from Dev-Centr.

entry.title: Installation concurrency when Windows has a mutex but not a queue
entry.summary: Windows does not queue GUI or CLI installs across process trees—agents hit MSI 1618, custom EXE races, and package-manager exit codes. What exists, what we fake in orchestration, and what a real serialization API would need.

entry.title: Installation concurrency when Linux locks wait—or don’t
entry.summary: Linux package managers serialize with lock files and, in modern apt, optional wait timeouts—but agents still bounce across dpkg, DNF, Flatpak, and GUI software centers. What exists, what to fake in orchestration, and who would need to cooperate for a real install bus.

entry.title: Why Git feels hard when features aren’t files
entry.summary: Git stores file blobs, not features or dependencies. That is why unrelated functions collide on pull, and why connectome-fs (now under Dev-Centr) treats semantic units and graph edges as filesystem-native.

entry.title: When code platforms flatten portfolios
entry.summary: GitHub spent the word Projects on boards, not on nesting product families under a portfolio. A short Dev-Centr note on forge ontology — with the HCI essay as the deeper cut.

entry.title: Business Bootstrap becomes a support-systems hub
